alt: Concept render of the OpenAI speaker — a fabric-covered donut/ring shape shown in a hand alongside diagrams labelled Spin, Tilt, and Click, with OpenAI logo and text reading 'Moving parts that help give it personality'
story: OpenAI acquired Jony Ive's design studio for $6.4 billion in 2025, assembled a 200-person hardware team, and unveiled its first product on August 6: a hockey-puck-sized ring speaker with no screen and 'moving parts for personality,' priced at $300–$400 and launching in 2027 — critics immediately compared it to the failed $699 Humane AI Pin.
why_funny: The world's most hyped AI company paid iPhone-designer money to put a hole in a speaker and give it fidget-toy features.
